sourcedFrom: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL (undated beyond "REVISED 7.26" on the back page)
cleanIntro:
The PWS MK2 MOD 2-M is an AR-pattern rifle that runs on PWS's long-stroke gas piston instead of direct impingement: a piston rod and piston head ride with the bolt carrier group, and an adjustable gas knob at the gas block sets 1 for unsuppressed shooting and 2 or 3 for suppressed shooting. The knob also has an X setting, which PWS says the rifle must never be fired on.

The routine strip is the familiar AR one with two piston-specific steps: upper off the lower, charging handle and bolt carrier group out together, then the piston head turned off the rod so the charging handle slides off. The MK2 MOD 2-M is the one PWS line whose handguard comes off for gas system maintenance, and that procedure is in Deep Clean.

steps.title: Unload, clear, on safe
steps.action: Point the muzzle in a safe direction and keep it there. Remove the magazine, lock the action open and look into the chamber to see it empty, then put the selector on safe.
steps.prose: Every later step has your hands on the bolt carrier group; a round left in the chamber is the mistake this step exists to catch.
steps.quote: Unload and clear your firearm, be sure your firearm is on safe.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL — Disassembly for Routine Maintenance, step 1, printed p.6

steps.title: Bolt carrier group forward
steps.action: Let the bolt carrier group go forward before you push any pins.
steps.prose: With the carrier forward the upper and lower separate cleanly; with it locked back they bind on each other.
steps.quote: Ensure the bolt carrier group is forward before proceeding.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL — Disassembly for Routine Maintenance, step 2, printed p.6

steps.title: Rear takedown pin to its detent
steps.action: Press the rear takedown pin from the left side toward the right until the detent in the lower receiver stops it.
steps.prose: The pin is captive: it stops at the detent and stays in the lower.
steps.quote: Press the back take-down pin from left to right until it is stopped by the detent in the lower receiver.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL — Disassembly for Routine Maintenance, step 3, printed p.6

steps.title: Front pivot pin to its detent
steps.action: Press the front pivot pin from left to right until the detent stops it in the same way.
steps.prose: Both pins push the same direction, left to right.
steps.quote: Press the front pivot pin from left to right until it is stopped by the detent in the lower receiver.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL — Disassembly for Routine Maintenance, step 4, printed p.6

steps.title: Upper off the lower
steps.action: Lift the upper receiver off the lower receiver.
steps.prose: Nothing else holds them together once both pins are at their detents.
steps.quote: At this time, the upper receiver and lower receiver will detach from each other.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL — Disassembly for Routine Maintenance, step 5, printed p.6

steps.title: Charging handle back to its stop
steps.action: Turn the upper 45 to 90 degrees so the charging handle faces away from you, then pull the charging handle out of the back of the upper receiver until it stops.
steps.prose: Turning the upper is PWS's own tip; it puts the charging handle where you can pull it straight.
steps.quote: Pull the charging handle from the back of the upper receiver until it stops.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL — Disassembly for Routine Maintenance, step 6, printed p.6

steps.title: Bolt carrier group back onto the charging handle
steps.action: Draw the bolt carrier group rearward until it catches on the charging handle.
steps.prose: On the piston gun the carrier and charging handle leave the upper together.
steps.quote: Pull the bolt carrier group back until it catches on the charging handle.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL — Disassembly for Routine Maintenance, step 7, printed p.6

steps.title: Carrier and charging handle out together
steps.action: Lift the bolt carrier group up, away from the charging handle, and draw the carrier with the charging handle out of the upper receiver.
steps.prose: The piston rod comes out with them, still running through the charging handle.
steps.quote: Lift the bolt carrier group up (away from the charging handle). The bolt carrier group with charging handle will now be free to pull away from the upper receiver.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL — Disassembly for Routine Maintenance, step 8, printed p.6

steps.title: Piston head off the rod
steps.action: Turn the piston head until it slips off the end of the piston rod.
steps.prose: If it will not slide, keep turning; it comes off easily at the right point.
steps.quote: Turn the piston head until it can easily slip off.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL — Disassembly for Routine Maintenance, step 9, printed p.6

steps.title: Charging handle off over the piston rod
steps.action: Slide the charging handle off over the piston rod.
steps.prose: With the piston head off, nothing stops the charging handle sliding off the rod.
steps.quote: Remove the charging handle over the piston rod.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL — Disassembly for Routine Maintenance, step 10, printed p.6

steps.title: Firing pin retaining pin out
steps.action: Pull the firing pin retaining pin out of the carrier; the firing pin is then free to come out of the back.
steps.prose: Keep the retaining pin with the carrier; it is small.
steps.quote: Remove firing pin retaining pin, which will release the firing pin.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL — Disassembly for Routine Maintenance, step 11, printed p.6

steps.title: Cam pin out — bolt held in
steps.action: Press the bolt assembly into the carrier, turn the cam pin 90 degrees and lift it out. Keep a hand on the bolt: it is spring assisted and separates easily once the cam pin is out.
steps.prose: With the cam pin out, the bolt comes out the front of the carrier.
steps.caution: Caution: the bolt assembly is spring assisted and will easily separate at this time.
steps.quote: Depress bolt assembly group into carrier, turn cam pin 90 degrees and remove.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL — Disassembly for Routine Maintenance, step 12, printed p.6

steps.title: Pressure on the extractor
steps.action: Press on the round side of the extractor to take the pressure off the extractor pin.
steps.prose: Hold that pressure through the next step, or the pin binds.
steps.quote: Apply pressure on the round side of the extractor to relieve pressure on extractor pin.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL — Disassembly for Routine Maintenance, step 13, printed p.6

steps.title: Extractor pin out
steps.action: With a punch or the tip of the firing pin, push the extractor pin out of the bolt, from either side.
steps.quote: Using a punch/tip of firing pin, push the extractor pin from the bolt; direction does not matter.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL — Disassembly for Routine Maintenance, step 14, printed p.6

steps.title: Extractor off the bolt
steps.action: Lift the extractor off the bolt.
steps.prose: Keep the extractor, its pin and the bolt together.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL — Disassembly for Routine Maintenance, step 15, printed p.6

steps.title: Buffer and recoil spring out of the lower
steps.action: In the lower receiver, press the buffer retainer down and draw the buffer and recoil spring out of the buffer tube.
steps.prose: The spring is under some tension; let it out under control.
steps.quote: In the lower receiver, depress the buffer retainer and remove the buffer and recoil spring.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL — Disassembly for Routine Maintenance, step 16, printed p.6

steps.title: Field strip complete
steps.action: On the bench: the upper receiver, the lower receiver, the bolt carrier, bolt, extractor and their pins, the firing pin, the cam pin, the piston rod and piston head, the charging handle, and the buffer and recoil spring. DEEP CLEAN carries PWS's MK2 MOD 2-M gas system maintenance: handguard off and the gas adjustment knob out of the gas block.
steps.prose: These are the sixteen steps PWS's lubrication page sends you through before cleaning.
steps.quote: To lubricate your firearm, follow disassembly instructions #1-16 on page 6.
steps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL — Lubrication, printed p.8

deepSteps.title: Gas knob to setting 2
deepSteps.action: With your rifle service tool, turn the gas adjustment knob to setting 2.
deepSteps.prose: Setting 2 is where the MK2 MOD 2-M procedure starts, and where the knob goes back in.
deepSteps.quote: Using your rifle service tool, turn the gas adjustment knob to setting 2.
deepSteps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL — Gas System Maintenance, MK2 MOD 2-M, step 1, printed p.9

deepSteps.title: Handguard screws back to their stop
deepSteps.action: With the cross-head end of the rifle service tool, back out the handguard screw on each side of the handguard until it stops, about three turns.
deepSteps.prose: The screws stop by themselves; you are loosening them, not taking them out.
deepSteps.quote: Using the cross head section of your rifle service tool unscrew the handguard screws on each side of the handguard until they come to a stop (approximately 3 turns)
deepSteps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL — Gas System Maintenance, MK2 MOD 2-M, step 2, printed p.9

deepSteps.title: Plate in, handguard forward
deepSteps.action: Push the handguard plate on the ejection-port side in toward the upper, then pull the handguard forward off the rifle.
deepSteps.prose: It should come off with very little force; if it fights you, the plate is not pushed in.
deepSteps.quote: Push the handguard plate on the ejection port side in, towards the upper, then pull the handguard forward to remove.
deepSteps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL — Gas System Maintenance, MK2 MOD 2-M, step 3, printed p.9

deepSteps.title: Gas knob turned and pulled out
deepSteps.action: Turn the gas adjustment knob 180 degrees, or until its roll pin faces up, and pull the knob out of the gas block.
deepSteps.prose: The roll pin facing up is the position at which the knob pulls free.
deepSteps.quote: Turn the gas adjustment knob 180 degrees or until roll pin is facing up and pull the knob out of the gas block.
deepSteps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL — Gas System Maintenance, MK2 MOD 2-M, step 4, printed p.9

deepSteps.title: PWS's stopping point
deepSteps.action: Stop here. Anything further apart than this is for a PWS Armorer; the gas block nut, barrel nut and bore evacuator are not owner work.
deepSteps.prose: PWS says the piston system is proprietary and needs PWS-made tools beyond this point.
deepSteps.quote: Disassembly further than shown in this manual should ONLY be done by a PWS Armorer.
deepSteps.cite: Primary Weapons Systems MK2 MOD 2-M Rifle / MOD 2-M Upper — Product Manual — REVISED 7.26 — printed on the back page; file name PWS-MK2-Manual-DIGITAL — Gas System / In-Depth Maintenance, printed p.8

cleaning.name: BOLT CARRIER GROUP
tasks: Flush the surfaces of the bolt carrier group with solvent.
A Scotch-Brite pad may be used on hardened carbon on the bolt carrier group parts and the piston head.
Reassemble the bolt carrier group, then lubricate all of it, every contact point well.
⚠ Piston rod and piston head: wipe them down before reassembly — PWS says they do not need lubrication.

cleaning.name: PISTON TUBE AND BUFFER TUBE
tasks: A .40 cal cleaning brush through the piston tube to clear carbon and debris.
Flush the buffer tube with solvent and remove the excess.
An even layer of lubricant inside the buffer tube.

cleaning.name: BARREL UNDER THE HANDGUARD
tasks: Carbon on the barrel under the handguard: oil and a brush or a cotton swab to rub it off.
PWS does not suggest taking the handguard off for barrel carbon; on the MK2 MOD 2-M it comes off for the gas system maintenance in Deep Clean.

cleaning.name: GAS SYSTEM
tasks: Deep clean: the piston tube and the gas block with a .40 cal cleaning brush.
Deep clean: the gas adjustment knob with a Scotch-Brite pad and/or a wire brush as needed.

reassembly: Deep clean only: gas adjustment knob back into the gas block, set to setting 2.

Deep clean only: handguard back on, leaving a slight air gap between the gas block and the handguard's interior rail — PWS warns that no gap can affect accuracy. PWS lists the MK2 handguard screws at 30 inch-pounds.
Extractor onto the bolt and its pin pushed back in; bolt into the carrier, cam pin in and turned, firing pin in from the rear and its retaining pin back in.
Charging handle back over the piston rod and the piston head turned back onto the rod.
Bolt carrier group and charging handle back into the upper receiver; buffer and recoil spring back into the buffer tube.
Upper back onto the lower; front pivot pin and rear takedown pin pushed back home.
⛔ Gas knob back to your normal setting — 1 unsuppressed, 2 or 3 suppressed. Never fire the rifle on X.
Run the function check before loading.
fncheck: PWS's book publishes no function check. Clear the rifle first. Confirm both receiver pins are fully home and the gas adjustment knob sits on setting 1, 2 or 3 — never X. Then clear the rifle again.
